CustomField.description: Status shown to the public: Overdue when the next inspection due date has passed, otherwise the latest inspection result.
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Next_Inspection_Due__c)), Next_Inspection_Due__c < TODAY()), "Overdue", IF(ISPICKVAL(Inspection_Status__c, ""), "Not Yet Inspected", TEXT(Inspection_Status__c)))
CustomField.label: Portal Status
